entries.02e600cac3f3cdfc: Manufacture and sale of food products centered on confectionery
entries.09b7cb12f79d05ff: The BOURBON Group consists of the company, four consolidated subsidiaries, one equity-method affiliate and seven unconsolidated subsidiaries.
entries.0b5d24dfa8e46129: Its management philosophy is 'enhancing the viability of the group, including those whose interests conflict', and its basic approach is to enhance viability together with all seven stakeholder groups: consumers, distributors, national, prefectural and municipal governments, shareholders, financial institutions, business partners and employees. Its mission is to continuously provide the innovative products and services consumers want, and it aims to remain a global company connected to the world while based in a regional area. In addition, it has newly formulated a medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years ended March 2027 through March 2029 and is working to expand its business.
entries.0e196c53c02cac9f: Manufactures and sells confectionery, beverages, food, frozen desserts and other products. The company is central, and its consolidated subsidiaries include Bolumeng (Changxing) Food Co., Ltd., which manufactures and sells confectionery for China and others; Bolumeng (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd., which sells products in China; Lehman Co., Ltd., which manufactures and sells chocolate and Western confectionery; and Echigo Beer Co., Ltd., which manufactures and sells beer and others. The equity-method affiliate Marukin Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells baumkuchen and others.
entries.14a64272ef0a3682: Revenue hit a new record high.
entries.15c4a71953528ac7: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥120,303 million (106.0% of the previous year), updating the record for revenue.
entries.1dba009f10fee77b: Centered on confectionery such as biscuits, rice crackers, chocolate, candy, desserts, bean confectionery and snacks, it manufactures and sells beverages, foods, frozen desserts and other products. Adhering to a principle of quality assurance first, it works to provide safe and reliable products on a stable basis.
entries.1dd3622407ea6f4d: A food manufacturer headquartered in Kashiwazaki, Niigata Prefecture, which makes and sells confectionery, mainly biscuits and rice crackers, as well as beverages, foods and frozen desserts.
entries.2141aac4308749ce: As a food manufacturer, it adheres to a quality-assurance-first principle and works to stably supply safe, reliable products of high substantive value. On the product side, it seeks to meet diversifying consumer needs through expanding product brands, adding functionality, and developing products using rare raw materials. For quality assurance, it operates the BOURBON Quality Assurance Management System (ＢＱＡＭＳ), which it formulated independently based on international food safety management system standards and the like.
entries.21ab326de776f80a: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥120,303 million (106.0% of the previous year), updating the record for revenue. By category, confectionery was ¥115,244 million and beverages, foods, frozen desserts and others were ¥5,058 million.
entries.230b3322722260b8: Of consolidated revenue of ¥120,303 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, confectionery accounted for the bulk at ¥115,244 million, and beverages, foods, frozen desserts and others for ¥5,058 million. Sales are mainly made through food wholesalers; revenue from Mitsubishi Shokuhin Co., Ltd., the principal customer, was ¥17,128 million, or 14.2% of consolidated revenue, followed by Confex Co., Ltd. and Takayama Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue.
